## Checklist

- [ ] The PR is focused on one change and the title follows Conventional Commits (`feat: …`, `fix: …`).
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and the checks in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) pass locally.
- [ ] Docs, `.env.example` and translations are updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, internal hostnames or personal data in code, fixtures or screenshots.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, [DCO](https://developercertificate.org/)).
